categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds a GitHub Actions CI workflow in .github/workflows/code-signing-certificate.yml to support release operations.
categories.rationale: Automated warning for code signing certificate expiry prevents release delays for expedited or patch releases. As noted in the discussion, code signing certificates are required for point releases and "always need to work (particularly in the case of expedited releases)." While valuable operational tooling for release maintainers, certificate renewal is infrequent and the check is deferrable.
